title: Awesome Alarm Clock Plus Charging Station
text: Awesome Alarm Clock Plus Charging Station. This alarm clock is amazing by the bedside and has multiple USB charging opportunities

product_metadata.title: Digital Alarm Clock with 3 USB Charger, SUPERDANNY Desk Charging Station 2 AC Outlets, 6.5ft Cord, Power Strip Surge Protector 1700J, LCD Display, Easy Alarm Setting for Bedroom Dorm Room Hotel, Black
features: 【3 Function in 1】Combining Alarm, Digital Clock, 2 AC Outlets, and 3 USB Ports in one, save your desktop or nightstand from looking messy with multiple devices.

【Adjustable Brightness】 4 levels of brightness available as you’d prefer. Find your comfort brightness without disturbing your sleep. The upper layer of the LED screen is the digital clock, and the lower number is the alarm clock.

【7-Fold Safety Protection】Fire-resistant material ABS+PC (1382℉, rating: UL94 V-0), surge protection (1700J), overload/short-circuit, USB over-voltage, over-current, over-heat protection, make it safe and functional.

【Multi-Plug Outlet Extender】With 2 widely spaced built-in outlets to accommodate bulky plug or adapter, and 3 smart USB ports to intelligently detect your iPhone, iPad, tablet, earbuds, and other electric devices and deliver them the fastest possible yet safe charging current up to 2.4A per port, 3.2A in total, who needs more outlets on the wall?

【Battery Backup】 With 2*AAA backup batteries (Not included) installed, it memorizes time and alarm settings even during power outages, with no need for constant time resetting. (Like most electronics, this alarm clock needs to be reset once every few months for its accuracy)

Note: Products with this type of electrical plugs are designed for use in the US. Outlets and voltage differ internationally, this product may require an adapter or converter before use. Please check compatibility before purchasing.
